column1: # Reviewed privileged-event jobs allowed on persistent runners (ADR 0235).
# The digest covers the job, its inherited workflow trigger/env/permissions/
# defaults, every calling job, the scanned-tree bytes the job puts on disk
# (exact non-cone sparse paths, cone-mode directories with root and parent
# files, local action directories), and its unresolved reasons. Any edit turns
# the entry STALE. The checker over-approximates: a fetch, a runtime tree
# change, a non-default shell, a full or runtime-selected checkout, submodules,
# or head detection that materializes or cannot decide leaves the job
# unresolved, and dynamic: must name exactly the reason categories the checker
# prints, with a justification specific to what this job fetches or changes.

column4: Runs only for merged PRs (trigger types: [closed], if: merged); sparse-checks out scripts/ci-gate/post-merge-reconcile.sh at pull_request.base.sha with persist-credentials false and executes only that script (its bytes are in this digest) plus inline gh/jq; head SHA/ref/repo are API identifiers; the merge-attestation-<run> artifact must come from a successful default-branch ai-review-merge.yml workflow_dispatch run and attestation.json is schema-validated with jq as data
column5: dynamic: fetch: every gh api call (step 2 and post-merge-reconcile.sh) returns JSON that only jq parses, plus one gh api download of the merge-attestation-<run> zip from the ai-review-merge.yml run that the check-run, review, and dispatch-job queries just validated; unzip -p extracts only attestation.json into a 0700 RUNNER_TEMP directory, jq schema-validates it, and the script reads it as data to file issues and delete the merged head ref; nothing fetched is executed or written into the checkout

column4: workflow_run of actions-ci: sparse-checks out only scripts/ci-gate/review-policy-envelope.py from Verjson/.github and executes only that decoder plus inline gh/jq; the triggering run's head SHA and PRs are API identifiers; the ai-review-arm receipt is read as data with jq and review_policy is regex-bounded before decoding
column5: dynamic: fetch, head-materialization, runtime-checkout: head detection and the runtime-checkout reason both come from the one checkout, Verjson/.github at steps.trusted-revision.outputs.sha, which the job sets from job.workflow_sha, the executing default-branch workflow revision that a workflow_run cannot take from the triggering PR; it sparse-checks out only scripts/ci-gate/review-policy-envelope.py (cone mode off), whose scanned bytes are in this digest; gh api returns check-run and run JSON read by jq, and gh run download extracts the ai-review-arm receipt into a mktemp RUNNER_TEMP directory removed on exit, where only receipt.json is read and its review_policy is regex-bounded before the decoder sees it; nothing fetched is executed

column4: Remote callee app-key-environment.yml pinned to full SHA ebe23faf: at that SHA it has no uses: or checkout step and no PR-head reference; validate runs on ubuntu-24.04 and validate-ai-review-key checks the App key environment inline

No checkout or source-fetching action; executes only inline bash and heredoc-authored Python from the base workflow plus gh/jq API calls; PR head SHA and number are compared as data; ai-review-arm-<run>-<attempt> receipts come from trusted gate-rearm runs whose workflow blob is matched to the default branch, are downloaded to a mktemp directory, and are read only as data with jq; caller workflow blobs fetched through the git/blobs API are hashed, never executed
column5: dynamic: fetch: the job has no checkout; gh api responses (check runs, runs, artifacts, PR files, git trees and blobs) are JSON parsed by jq or by json.loads in the heredoc-authored bootstrap classifier, and fetched workflow blobs are hashed and compared, never executed; gh run download extracts ai-review-arm receipts into fresh mktemp RUNNER_TEMP directories that are read only with jq and removed; the urllib match is urllib.parse.quote, URL encoding with no network access
